name: LaserFont outside-face upward arrow
front_convention: One upward arrow before the complete ID, pointing toward the top of the readable lettering. Read arrow and ID together from the final outside face.
geometry: One simple arrow made from two open zero-width polylines; no closed hole.
qualification: The arrow alone is symmetric. The before-ID placement and up direction together distinguish the complete label. This is a text-reading cue, not an assembly UP instruction. Outside-face placement, actual CAM and physical readability need separate verification.
